text: A collage header can pass the art director and the picture desk and still ship with an unreadable type block: on 2026-11-17 the paper_collage render put the kicker, title and hook over paper modules, and the hook line was buried behind the collage on the live page. The overlay's empty-spot search cannot see busy detail, and --anchor only moves the block, it does not clear the ground. Two consequences: (1) inspect the composited featured.jpg with vision before the push, not just the render, and (2) when the copy is three lines, commission a treatment whose composition leaves an open field (a cinematic still with a dark scrim beats a dense collage), because illustration_overlay.py re-derives its copy from the article each run and ignores a hook cleared in featured.json.

publish.py can finish GREEN with no illustration: the artifact leaves the push without image_* frontmatter and the CMS post is created with featured_media 0, so the first live render is hero-less and og:image falls back to /default-share-image.png. Check the published artifact for image_path immediately after publish; repair in-run with illustration_creator.py --apply <artifact>, then wp_draft.py --slug <slug> --refresh --refresh-live (attaches media, keeps the post live), then toggle status draft->publish via the WordPress client (credentials_for + load_env) because a same-status PATCH does not fire the front build; the build itself takes 15-20 minutes.
